summary.text: 怎 asks “how?” or “in what way?” Its analyzed construction pairs 心, marking the heart or mind category, with 乍 as a phonetic element.

formation.text: 怎 is analyzed as a phonosemantic compound: 心 contributes the heart or mind category, and 乍 supplies a sound cue. The available readings do not independently confirm the historical sound match within this graph.

components.text: 心 contributes the heart or mind meaning category in the analysis of 怎. The selected seal-script-style image is a modern rendering, not a dated early form of this graph.
乍 is identified as the phonetic component. The cited readings permit comparison, but no matched historical reconstruction for 乍 and 怎 establishes their sound relation in this character.

sound_limitation.text: The Middle Chinese reading cited for 怎 belongs to a proposed account of 作勿生／作沒生; it is not an independently established reading of this graph. No matched historical reconstruction for 乍 and 怎 establishes their sound relation in this character.

sound.text: Both are current Mandarin readings. Their difference alone neither confirms nor rules out an earlier sound relation.

history.text: The selected seal-script-style images illustrate 心 and 乍, the components named in the analysis of 怎. They are modern digital renderings, not dated artifacts bearing 怎, and do not show a sequence of changes in its written form.

Historical discussions report expressions including 作勿生、作沒生 and 作摩／作麼 alongside 怎生 and 怎么. These are proposed histories of spoken interrogative expressions; they do not show that the whole graph 怎 was borrowed from another character.

One study adopts a proposed sound-and-meaning account linking 作勿生／作沒生 with later interrogative expressions. A competing account connects 怎生 with 作麽生, possibly treating 怎 as a contraction of 作麽, while noting that the forms’ dates do not settle which came first. The full sequence among these forms and 爭 remains unresolved.

uncertainties.text: The 心-plus-乍 analysis is supported, but the graph’s earliest form, first appearance, intermediate forms, and any graphic corruption remain undetermined in the supplied evidence.
No independent Middle Chinese or Old Chinese reconstruction for 怎 is supplied to establish a matched historical comparison with 乍; the reported tsak belongs to a lexical proposal concerning 作勿生／作沒生.
The lexical relationship among 作勿／作沒, 作麽生, 怎生, 怎么, and 爭 remains unresolved; the supplied evidence does not establish a complete semantic or phonological path.
The listed Japanese readings do not establish a Japanese-origin history for 怎.

Modern dictionary data also glosses 怎 as “what?”; the timing and relationship of this use to “how” are not established.

limitations.text: The cited interrogative uses do not establish a chronology between “how” and “what,” or the character’s original meaning.

evidence.source: wiktionary
evidence.text:
Phono-semantic compound (形聲 /形声): phonetic 乍 (OC *zraːɡs) + semantic 心 (“heart”).
First attested in the word 怎生 [10th c.] (Yuan et al., 1996).
Contraction of 作 (MC tsak) + some variant of 物 (MC mjut, “thing; what”), literally “to do what” (Norman, 1988). This is evidenced in forms found in the Tang and Song dynasties (Yuan et al., 1996): 作勿生 (MC tsak mjut sraeng) [8th c.], 作沒生 (MC tsak mwot sraeng) [8th c.], 作摩 (MC tsak ma) [10th c.], 作麼 (MC tsak maX) [10th c.].

evidence.source: 中國語言學會期刊資料平台所收論文（2012）
evidence.field: 疑問詞「怎／怎么」的來源與年代討論
evidence.text: 論文回顧數種分析：有研究把唐代《神會語錄》中的「作勿生」「作沒生」視為「怎么」的早期書寫形式，並據《敦煌變文集》記「怎生」五例；另有分析認為「怎」由「作」受「么」聲母影響而變音，怎生則是「怎么生」的縮約。論文同時指出《祖堂集》作「作摩」「作摩生」，《景德傳燈錄》有「怎么」例，將材料排列為八世紀「作勿生、作沒生」、八至十世紀若干變體、十世紀後半以後「怎么、怎」。作者採納語音與語義較能相通的來源說，但文中所述為詞語史研究，不能據此證明「怎」字形本身的最早出現或所有字形演變環節。
evidence.title: 疑问词语“怎么”的来源及相关问题

evidence.source: Doosho transcription of 呂叔湘, 近代漢語指代詞
evidence.text: 此書稱「爭」約八世紀出現且來源未明，並討論「作麽生」與「爭」或「怎生」語音可通；提出「怎生」可能來自「作麽生」（「怎」為「作麽」合音），但明言兩形式年代相近，難判先後。這與把作勿／作沒直接縮合為怎的分析並非完全相同，應保留為競爭或並存的詞源解釋。
evidence.title: 近代漢語指代詞

evidence.text: 資料庫列出乍的甲骨文、金文、楚系簡帛、小篆等字形欄位，並稱乍為作的本字；其甲骨文字形被解作上衣衣襟，表示製作衣服，後來加人旁成作。該解釋涉及乍自身的字源，不等同於怎的構形說明；怎中乍的聲符功能由另一字書直接提出。

evidence.source: 中國語言學會期刊資料平台所收論文（2012）
evidence.field: 疑問詞「怎／怎么」的來源與年代討論
evidence.text: 論文回顧數種分析：有研究把唐代《神會語錄》中的「作勿生」「作沒生」視為「怎么」的早期書寫形式，並據《敦煌變文集》記「怎生」五例；另有分析認為「怎」由「作」受「么」聲母影響而變音，怎生則是「怎么生」的縮約。論文同時指出《祖堂集》作「作摩」「作摩生」，《景德傳燈錄》有「怎么」例，將材料排列為八世紀「作勿生、作沒生」、八至十世紀若干變體、十世紀後半以後「怎么、怎」。作者採納語音與語義較能相通的來源說，但文中所述為詞語史研究，不能據此證明「怎」字形本身的最早出現或所有字形演變環節。
evidence.title: 疑问词语“怎么”的来源及相关问题

evidence.source: Doosho transcription of 呂叔湘, 近代漢語指代詞
evidence.text: 此書稱「爭」約八世紀出現且來源未明，並討論「作麽生」與「爭」或「怎生」語音可通；提出「怎生」可能來自「作麽生」（「怎」為「作麽」合音），但明言兩形式年代相近，難判先後。這與把作勿／作沒直接縮合為怎的分析並非完全相同，應保留為競爭或並存的詞源解釋。
evidence.title: 近代漢語指代詞

context.provenance: Base evidence consists of imported local JSONL excerpts. Source names identify upstream datasets; extraction may lose sense and language boundaries. Further external evidence and research activity are documented separately in the dossier.
editorial_rules: Write about the character's graphic history; distinguish it from the history of a spoken word.
Separate historical explanation from mnemonics. Do not infer history from modern shapes or readings.
Sources may repeat one another. A source count is not independent corroboration.
Treat Shuowen as a historical account, not automatic confirmation. Its generated English glosses are excluded.
Unrelated word senses may appear in Wiktionary excerpts. Do not merge them into a character origin.
Related-character evidence retains its record_character. Do not silently transfer a traditional form's components to a simplified form.
No glyph image has been visually inspected in this packet. Do not claim to have inspected one.
Explain missing evidence explicitly, especially for Japanese-created characters. A Chinese spelling pronunciation is not evidence for a Japanese origin.

gaps: No visually inspected manuscript or inscription containing 怎 was found; this research therefore does not establish its earliest graphic form, exact first attestation as a graph, or intermediate graphic changes/corruption.

The reported eighth-century 作勿生／作沒生 forms and later 怎生、作摩、作麼 forms are cited in a secondary study to historical texts. The manuscripts/editions themselves were not inspected, so dates and readings remain reported datings rather than direct primary-source verification.

The proposed lexical path from 作 + 物 to 怎／怎麼 is disputed against analyses involving 作麽生 and the independently occurring interrogative 爭; the semantic and phonological transitions are not fully established by the accessed sources.

No evidence here shows that 怎 is a whole-graph phonetic loan. The evidence instead supports a graphic analysis of 心 semantic plus 乍 phonetic, alongside separate proposed lexical histories for the spoken interrogative forms.
